name: Bootstrap Support
description: Bootstrap class-name completion and hover (from bootstrap.css) for class="..." in .html/.htm files. Priority 500. Runs the stock html server and the Emmet server (@olrtg/emmet-language-server) behind a small proxy so normal HTML and Emmet features keep working. Skips Angular workspaces (the Angular plugin handles those). Also renders the Bootstrap logo inline next to every recognised Bootstrap class name, using the same bootstrap.css index as the language server.
